issue.title: sase_beads.md calls issues.jsonl a generated projection; since sase-1h8.11 it is a git-ignored on-demand export

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
In "Store And IDs", replace "`issues.jsonl` is a generated projection." with: "`issues.jsonl` is a git-ignored on-demand export (`sase bead export`), never committed or rewritten per mutation, so never read it as current state."

Apply the same correction to the init memory template src/sase/main/init_memory/templates/memory-sase-beads.template.md (line 19 says "`issues.jsonl` is a generated projection"). Then run `sase memory init`.

Why: since epic sase-1h8 phase sase-1h8.11 (projection-off, ee0021821f + sase-core 7df86f4a), event stores no longer write issues.jsonl on save. The file is in .gitignore and untracked in the beads sidecar, so any local copy may be missing or stale. Found by the sase-1h8 land agent on 2026-10-09. The epic's plan forbade phase workers from editing memory.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1h8 took issues.jsonl off the commit path; its plan barred memory edits, so the land agent files the stale wording for an authorized writer.

payload.description: Both correct sase_beads.md; one memory edit can address both
